description: Read Nightbot chat settings and manage custom commands, timers and regulars.

nightbot_command_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a nightbot command changes in Nightbot. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields _id, name, message, userLevel, coolDown, count, updatedAt

nightbot_new_command_trigger.description: Runs for each new Nightbot command in Nightbot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields _id, name, message, userLevel, coolDown, count, updatedAt

nightbot_new_regular_trigger.description: Runs for each new Nightbot regular in Nightbot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

nightbot_new_timer_trigger.description: Runs for each new Nightbot timer in Nightbot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
